about: M11 Delivery Room — JSON fixture of the aggregated view contract (GET /api/deliveries/:id, .ifrim/M11_DESIGN.md → DELIVERY ROOM UI). Synthetic data only. Two variants hold ONLY the documented fields — plus plans[].steps[].kind, which the Room reads to tell a capture step: READY (after the reference clip revision: v2 current, v1 superseded with real links) and STALE (the workspace changed after the owner's acceptance). The plan steps (kind + title), the criteria, the start command, the changed files, the label item id and the marker notes are the REAL ones of the booking fixture (server/delivery/template.mjs packageSteps / revisionSteps, server/factory/booking-demo-def.mjs, server/delivery/clip-ir.mjs); m11-ui-logic.test.mjs M11-UI-18 keeps them equal. Used by v2/tests/m11-ui-logic.test.mjs.
